notes.title: Mika's Battle S 3 is now live on Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/8913b50173c5499a95b18d02256acf454cdba7df.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new title called Mika's Battle S 3 which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Anime themed action games, this might be the game for you. [i][b]This is the final installment of the series.
[/b][/i]
[h1]Check it out now: [/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745510/Mikas_Battle_S_3/


Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

[h1]Get Mega Anime Bundle here:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26008/Mega_Anime_Bundle/

Or, [b]you can get the complete collection of Mika's Battle S series here: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48323/Anamiks_Anime_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik
